items.name: Uppsalaligan 5: X - 2024

venue.name: [Österledskyrkan](https://osterledskyrkan.se/valkommen-till-forsamlingen/hyr-vara-lokaler/)
venue.details: Fritidslokalen. Enter using the staircase at the building's southern corner. No entrance before 5 pm.

items.information:
Varmt välkomna till den sista deltävlingen i höstsäsongen av Uppsalaligan 2024! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet (eller tidigare deltagande i serien).

Mer information om Uppsalaligans upplägg finns under fliken med samma namn. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information.

--

A warm welcome to the last competition in the autumn season of Uppsalaligan 2024! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience (or participation earlier in the league). 

More information about the league's structure can be found under the tab with the same name. Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information.

[![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.name: Barberton Mini 5 2024
items.information:
This competition is taking place on a **Monday** night!

Given the nature of the competition everyone **WILL** be expected to help out with judging, running, and scrambling. If you have any questions please ask before registering. 

Due to the size of the meeting room **PLEASE** limit the number of guests to **ONE**

If time permits we will do our best to add another round of 3x3.
